Hi Claire — thanks for the note and the estimate file. I skimmed the CSV and it’s helpful — appreciate the breakout by environment and average daily traffic.

Short answers up front:
- Retention: we offer both flat SKU buckets (good for predictable, steady-state workloads) and metered (GB/month) for spikier customers. Each has trade-offs on unit price and overage controls.
- Tracing: quota covers span ingestion; sampling policy can be customer-controlled or we can supply an agent-side sample that reduces ingestion.
- Advanced dashboards: licensed per-project with an option to add viewer seats; larger commits can negotiate a seat-inclusive bundle.

I can put together two example packages (SKU-buckets + 12mo and metered + 12–18mo) with suggested discounts and a pilot credit line. Does Thursday 9/17 at 10am PT work for a quick call?

If that works I’ll bring pricing scenarios and loop in Lauren from Sales Ops to run the discount math.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Hi Claire — thanks for the context and for joining today’s call. Below is a concise proposal we can put into a short SOW for procurement. I’m attaching a draft SOW (Redwood-SOW-draft.docx).

Option A — SKU buckets (predictable)
- 180-day prod retention: pick the 2TB bucket (covers projected growth) at $X/month (flat).
- Tracing: 1M spans included in bucket; additional spans $Y / million.
- Dashboards: project license at $Z / project + $W / viewer seat.
- Good for customers who want predictable monthly cost and simple overage handling.

Option B — Metered (GB/month) with tiered unit pricing (recommended for spiky growth)
- Storage billed at $A / GB-month with tier breaks at 5TB and 20TB. (Breakeven vs SKU at ~3.6TB/month).
- Tracing billed at $B / million spans with auto-sampling defaults (we recommend 7% global sampling + 100% capture for error traces for Skylark’s profile).
- Dashboards handled same as Option A.

Discount ladder (commit-based) — example bands
- Commit $60k/year -> 7% off list + $5k pilot credit
- Commit $180k/year -> 12% off list + $15k pilot credit
- Commit $400k/year -> 18% off list + $40k pilot credit

Other commercial notes:
- We can offer a 3-month pilot (pilot credits applied to first invoice) to validate retention and sampling settings.
- Overage protections: alerts at 75/90% of tier; automatic throttles can be put in place if enabled.
- For renewal: we’ll run a usage reconciliation and adjust the following year’s tier with a 30-day notice.

Next steps:
1) If you’re comfortable with either Option A or B, we’ll convert the draft SOW to a procurement-ready quote and route for signatures.
2) If Skylark wants a blended approach (SKU for logs + metered for traces), we can model costs and show the blended quote.
3) Procurement asks: confirm preferred commit band for an initial quote (pick one of the three above).

Claire — happy to jump back on a 20-min follow-up with procurement to walk through the SOW.

Best regards,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
